en.title: The business case for switching LLM providers
en.titleCore: The business case for switching LLM providers
en.description: How CFOs should price migration, dual-running, quality risk, concentration risk, and payback before changing AI providers.
en.body:
The business case for changing LLM providers is the savings curve after all switching costs, not the difference between two list prices. Include migration, evaluation, parallel operation, contract commitments, quality risk, reliability, compliance, and the value of reducing concentration risk.

Separate one-time and recurring cost

One-time cost includes migration engineering, test-set creation, evaluation, data movement, and contract work. Recurring cost includes gateway operation, monitoring, support, minimum commitments, and standby capacity. Show both so a temporary implementation bill is not confused with the new run rate.

Model the downside

Use conservative, base, and upside cases. Stress test quality, provider reliability, traffic growth, and the percentage of workloads that can actually move. Include a rollback plan and the cost of running both providers during the transition.

Price concentration risk

A second provider may cost more in steady state but reduce the financial exposure of a single outage, price change, or contract dispute. Put the value of optionality beside the direct savings. It is not a reason to diversify blindly; it is a reason to make the risk explicit.

Make the renewal decision

Approve a switch only when the payback period, quality floor, exit terms, and accountable owner are clear. Sometimes the best decision is a routing policy that keeps two providers and moves only eligible workloads. The decision should be revisited when usage or provider economics change.

Provider choice is a capital allocation decision disguised as a technical preference. Price the option before the renewal window closes.

  • LLM purchasing guide
  • Model concentration risk
  • Provider arbitrage

faq.question: What is the business case for switching LLM providers?
faq.answer: Compare fully loaded post-migration savings with engineering, evaluation, dual-running, contract, quality, compliance, and operating costs.

faq.question: How should a CFO model provider-switching risk?
faq.answer: Use conservative, base, and upside cases for quality, reliability, traffic, movable workload, rollback, and temporary parallel operation.

faq.question: Can keeping two providers be cheaper than switching?
faq.answer: Yes. Routing only eligible workloads can preserve optionality and reduce concentration risk when full replacement has a long or uncertain payback.

es.title: El caso de negocio para cambiar de proveedor LLM
es.titleCore: El caso de negocio para cambiar de proveedor LLM
es.description: Cómo valorar migración, doble operación, calidad, concentración y retorno antes de cambiar.
es.body:
El caso de negocio no es la diferencia entre dos precios de lista. Incluye migración, evaluación, operación paralela, compromisos, calidad, fiabilidad y riesgo de concentración.

Separa costes

Distingue migración, pruebas y contratos de los costes recurrentes de gateway, soporte, monitorización y capacidad de reserva.

Modela el riesgo

Usa escenarios conservador, base y optimista para calidad, fiabilidad, crecimiento y trabajo realmente migrable. Incluye rollback y doble operación.

Decide

Aprueba solo con retorno, umbral de calidad, condiciones de salida y responsable claros. A veces conviene routing entre dos proveedores.

faq.question: ¿Qué incluye el caso de negocio?
faq.answer: Ahorro total después de migración frente a ingeniería, evaluación, doble operación, contrato, calidad, cumplimiento y operación.

fr.title: Business case d’un changement de fournisseur LLM
fr.titleCore: Business case d’un changement de fournisseur LLM
fr.description: Évaluer migration, double fonctionnement, qualité, concentration et retour avant de changer.
fr.body:
Le business case ne compare pas deux prix catalogue. Il inclut migration, évaluation, fonctionnement parallèle, engagements, qualité, fiabilité et risque de concentration.

Séparer les coûts

Distinguez coûts ponctuels de migration, tests et contrats des coûts récurrents de passerelle, support, suivi et capacité de secours.

Modéliser le risque

Utilisez des scénarios prudent, central et haut pour qualité, fiabilité, croissance et charge réellement transférable. Incluez retour arrière et double fonctionnement.

Parfois le routage de deux fournisseurs offre un meilleur retour qu’un remplacement complet.

faq.question: Que contient le business case d’un changement?
faq.answer: Les économies après migration comparées aux coûts d’ingénierie, évaluation, double fonctionnement, contrat, qualité et exploitation.

de.title: Der Business Case für einen LLM-Anbieterwechsel
de.titleCore: Der Business Case für einen LLM-Anbieterwechsel
de.description: Migration, Parallelbetrieb, Qualität, Konzentrationsrisiko und Amortisation vor dem Wechsel bewerten.
de.body:
Der Business Case vergleicht nicht zwei Listenpreise. Er umfasst Migration, Evaluation, Parallelbetrieb, Verpflichtungen, Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit und Konzentrationsrisiko.

Kosten trennen

Unterscheiden Sie einmalige Migration, Tests und Vertragsarbeit von laufendem Gateway, Support, Monitoring und Reservekapazität.

Risiko modellieren

Rechnen Sie konservativ, als Basis und optimistisch für Qualität, Zuverlässigkeit, Wachstum und migrierbare Workloads. Planen Sie Rollback und Parallelbetrieb.

Routing über zwei Anbieter kann wirtschaftlicher sein als ein vollständiger Ersatz.

faq.question: Was gehört in den Business Case?
faq.answer: Einsparungen nach der Migration gegenüber Engineering, Evaluation, Parallelbetrieb, Vertrag, Qualität und laufendem Betrieb.

ja.title: LLMプロバイダー切り替えの事業ケース
ja.titleCore: LLMプロバイダー切り替えの事業ケース
ja.description: 移行、二重運用、品質、集中リスク、回収期間を切り替え前に評価する方法です。
ja.body:
事業ケースは2つの価格表の差ではありません。移行、評価、二重運用、契約、品質、信頼性、集中リスクを含めます。

費用を分ける

移行開発、テスト、契約の一時費用と、ゲートウェイ、監視、サポート、待機容量の継続費用を分けます。

リスクをモデル化する

品質、信頼性、成長率、実際に移行できるワークロードを保守・標準・上振れで計算し、ロールバックと二重運用を含めます。

完全移行より2社をルーティングする方が有利なこともあります。

faq.question: 切り替えの事業ケースには何を含めますか？
faq.answer: 移行後の節約と、開発、評価、二重運用、契約、品質、コンプライアンス、運用費を比較します。

pt.title: O caso de negócio para mudar de fornecedor LLM
pt.titleCore: O caso de negócio para mudar de fornecedor LLM
pt.description: Como avaliar migração, operação dupla, qualidade, concentração e retorno antes da mudança.
pt.body:
O caso de negócio não é a diferença entre dois preços de tabela. Inclui migração, avaliação, operação paralela, compromissos, qualidade, fiabilidade e risco de concentração.

Separe os custos

Diferencie migração, testes e contratos dos custos recorrentes de gateway, suporte, monitorização e capacidade de reserva.

Modele o risco

Use cenários conservador, base e otimista para qualidade, fiabilidade, crescimento e carga migrável. Inclua rollback e operação dupla.

Por vezes, o routing entre dois fornecedores tem melhor retorno do que uma substituição total.

faq.question: O que entra no caso de negócio?
faq.answer: Poupança após a migração comparada com engenharia, avaliação, operação dupla, contrato, qualidade, conformidade e operação.
